name: Shinguuji Korekiyo
source:
"So… I have an interest in it. I wonder what kind of beauty humans will display under these trying circumstances."

In order to study folklore, he has visited various areas and met with many people. From those experiences, he has formed a pet theory of “humanity’s unlimited beauty”, how humans have “limitless beauty” and even under the trying circumstances of being trapped, he watches his fellow students eagerly to see what kind of beauty they will display. Korekiyo has a creepy appearance, and his fundamental values are a bit off from a normal person’s. He is also a cool, level headed, and intelligent person.

[Edited from [url=http://jinjojess.tumblr.com/post/153867632773/ndrv3-famitsu-info-for-december-1st-2016-like-i]jinjojess's translation[/url]]
